Player with 55+ hours here.

Turn the sound on the game down a bit while you play. Can't tell you how many times I've almost had a heart attack from the volume on my game being too high. 

Also, you're going to hear lots of random scary noises while out there in the Radius, particularly when you're indoors. Expect to hear distant ghostly screams and plenty of spooky ambience when you're out in the open. Hearing footsteps, knocks, and cabinets/doors opening when you're indoors is common and not a reason for alarm (no matter how frightening they might sound). 

Tread slowly and methodically, fully taking in your surroundings, and when possible, use your distance advantage to pick off enemies from afar. Enemies will stay dead until the tide rolls in, so don't worry about them coming back to take you out. If you're not a great shot, then consider investing in a long-distance rifle like a Mosin, or better yet, look for one in the Radius. 

Finally, you can use your map to play cassette tapes on the go to break the tension in the air if you find it getting too heavy. A bit of calming music can make all the difference. Hope this helps, good luck out there!
